verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart: the frame borders, the peach swatch and the empty photo frames sit in a row like a sprite sheet, the food photos shrink to small thumbnails, the divider swashes float on their own, and 'Cascadia', 'RESTAURANT' and the URL end up in separate places. B has the same problems and worse ones: an isolated pasta-pattern tile becomes the hero, the food photos are tiny thumbnails at the bottom, and the empty frames and swashes clutter the corners. A wins narrowly because its headline leads from the top-left and its photos are a little more visible.
